climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A small Central Coast AVA in California's San Luis Obispo County, west of Paso Robles. Vineyards sit mostly around 1,500 feet in mountain terrain, about seven miles from the Pacific, and the climate is cooler and wetter than Paso Robles. The first vineyard here was planted in the 1870s.
